name: Astor's Letter of Introduction
summary: Astor Hadren carries a letter between Silverpine Forest and the Undercity. Deathstalkers use it to pose as the courier and investigate Andron Gant, a shopkeeper suspected of leaking Forsaken intelligence.

sections.title: A Courier's Credentials
sections.body: Astor Hadren carries messages between Silverpine Forest and the Undercity. His letter of introduction gives its bearer credentials with illicit contacts in the city. Mennet Carkad, a Deathstalker handler, needs to investigate suspicious leaks in the Undercity, and Astor's travels make him a target. An operative can eliminate Astor and take his papers, then assume his identity and intercept the covert messages meant for him.

sections.title: The Sting at the Apothecarium
sections.body: Mennet Carkad uses the recovered letter to deceive Andron Gant, a shopkeeper near the Apothecarium. Lord Varimathras suspects Gant of leaking Forsaken intelligence to an unknown third party. An undercover operative presents the letter as the expected contact. Gant trusts the bearer, giving the operative a chance to learn who his conspirators are and find proof of his treason.

faq.q: What is Astor's Letter of Introduction used for?
faq.answer: Mennet Carkad uses Astor's letter to fool the shopkeeper Andron Gant. The bearer poses as courier Astor Hadren to uncover Gant's secret dealings.
Astor Hadren was an emissary and messenger who carried private correspondence along the roads between Silverpine Forest and the Undercity. Deathstalker agents intercepted him.

faq.q: Why does Mennet Carkad want this letter?
faq.answer: Mennet Carkad needs the letter to test recruits seeking to join the Deathstalkers and to run a sting against Andron Gant, whom Lord Varimathras suspects of treason.

faq.q: Does Andron Gant suspect the letter is stolen?
faq.answer: No. Mennet says Gant lacks the wit to suspect foul play, and Gant accepts the bearer as the regular messenger sent by his conspirators.

angles.text: As a Forsaken rogue, you can use Astor's letter in a field exercise for entry into the Deathstalkers. It tests assassination, theft, and impersonation.
As an undead, you can see the Undercity's internal paranoia in this scheme. Lord Varimathras uses the Deathstalkers to root out subversion among the Forsaken.
